user.title: Energy entities
user.description: Pick the lifetime energy counters for your system. Each must be a sensor with a state class of total or total_increasing - a power sensor in watts will not work, because the report reads long-term statistics. House load is worked out from these, so there is nothing to pick for it. Optionally add a solar power sensor in watts to show the day's peak.

data.pv_power: Solar power (W, optional, for the peak)

rates.title: Prices
rates.description:
Point the price entities at whatever holds your current price: a tariff sensor, or an entity from a planner. It does not have to be in the sensor domain; a mirror sensor is created so the price is recorded and every kilowatt-hour can be valued at the rate in force when it moved. Periods from before the mirror existed use the entity's average rate if it has one, otherwise the fallback below - never the price showing at the moment the report runs, which in the evening is usually the peak.

The planner savings fields are optional: a running total of savings such as Predbat's, shown at the end of the report but not added to the total.

data.arbitrage_sensor: Planner savings counter (optional, shown for reference)
data.arbitrage_gate: Only count savings when this entity...

delivery.title: Messaging
delivery.description: How the report is sent. Telegram gets the formatted version with bold headings; other methods get plain text. The next page asks for the chat or device.

delivery_details.title: Messaging details
delivery_details.description:
Telegram: pick the chat entities your Telegram bot created, or type chat IDs separated by commas (group chats start with a minus sign), or both.

Notify entity: pick one or more, for example your phone's.

Notify service: the service name, for example notify.mobile_app_my_phone.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: Which reports to send and when. Weekly reports go out on Mondays and monthly ones on the 1st. The daily report can wait for sunset when that falls after the chosen time. These can also be changed from the device page.

error.not_a_total: That sensor has no long-term statistics. It needs a state class of total or total_increasing - pick the kWh counter, not the W power sensor.
error.not_a_measurement: That sensor has no max statistic. Pick a solar power sensor in watts with a state class of measurement.
error.bad_chat_id: Chat IDs must be whole numbers separated by commas, for example -1001234567890, 12345678.
error.no_chat: Pick at least one Telegram chat or type a chat ID.
error.no_telegram: The Telegram bot integration is not set up, so there is nothing to send through.
error.unknown_service: There is no such service. Check the name under Developer tools > Actions.

energy.title: Energy entities
energy.description: The lifetime energy counters the report reads. Reports reach back through history, so a report covering a period from before a change reads the new counter for all of it. Change these when you replace a device or picked the wrong entity, not routinely.

data.pv_power: Solar power (W, optional, for the peak)
